mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_template (shop_id, name, type, amount, min_amount, total_count, start_time, end_time, receive_start_time, receive_end_time, use_start_time, use_end_time, per_user_limit, max_discount_amount, status) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{minAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{receiveStartTime}, #{receiveEndTime}, #{useStartTime}, #{useEndTime}, #{perUserLimit}, #{maxDiscountAmount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET shop_id = #{shopId}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, receive_start_time = #{receiveStartTime}, receive_end_time = #{receiveEndTime}, use_start_time = #{useStartTime}, use_end_time = #{useEndTime}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, max_discount_amount = #{maxDiscountAmount}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE coupon_template SET issued_count = issued_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND issued_count < total_count AND NOW() BETWEEN COALESCE(receive_start_time, start_time) AND COALESCE(receive_end_time, end_time)
UPDATE coupon_template SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
